cases.title: Current aggregate formula edit and save
preconditions: Task-owned simulator with local service 3173 and isolated existing fixture.
steps: Seed only the dedicated local sheet with numeric, text and blank references.
Open the sheet and check six aggregate results.
Set A1=48 and C1 =SUM(A1,A2,A3) through the native formula bar; save and reopen.
Read the document through authenticated API, compare exact cells and export using fresh current code.
Log out native and API sessions; retain isolated fixture for inspection.
assertions: B1:B6 are 0,48,48,48,-8,1 after editing and reopening; C1 is 48.
API cells preserve exact formula strings.

results.notes: Installed 0.1.2 (3); all 10 dist files match byte-for-byte and assets contain no stale files.

Dedicated local account logged in; workspace shows one document and 193 B / 3 GB. Initial automation input lost trailing characters; separated text input and observation before focus changes succeeded.
Existing iOS outage fixture displays marker 5031213 and word count 7. Read-only UI check; no new save or API readback claimed.
simctl terminate/launch returned new PID 17719. Workspace reopened for the same account with the existing document.
Account settings logout returned to login with empty email/password. No document changes or deletions.

Dedicated local fixture initially renders B1:B6 as 0,12,12,12,-8,1. Native formula-bar edit changed A1 to 48 and added C1 =SUM(A1,A2,A3); save and reopen render 0,48,48,48,-8,1 and C1=48. Authenticated API deeply matches all cells, revision 4. Current-code XLSX conversion of readback passes seven cached results; running port-3173 server predates the formula fix and its API export failed. Native share sheet not tested. Fixture retained; UI/API sessions logged out.
Opening existing content does not prove editing or synchronization.

exclusions: Physical devices, landscape, keyboard and IME regression.
Current-build three-editor edits, Office import/export, offline and 503 regression.
Port-3173 process started before formula fix: its XLSX export failed; fresh-code conversion passed separately. No native share-sheet export pass claimed.
